title: Relation of Biology with Other Sciences
topicTitle: Relation of biology with other sciences
notes: **Biochemistry:** studies chemical processes in living organisms. Explains metabolism, enzyme action, DNA replication and protein synthesis in molecular terms.
**Biophysics:** applies physics principles to biological systems. Examples: X-ray crystallography for protein structure, fluid mechanics in blood flow, optics in microscopy.
**Biomathematics:** applies statistics, probability and modelling to biology. Population growth models, genetic inheritance probabilities, epidemiological modelling.
**Biotechnology:** uses living systems to develop products. Genetic engineering, fermentation, cloning, stem cell therapy.
**Geology and palaeontology:** study of fossils and rock layers reveals evolutionary history and past climates.
**Chemistry:** provides tools for analysis (chromatography, spectroscopy) and explains metabolic pathways through reaction mechanisms.
